spec/ARCHITECTURE.md:The gateway exposes one generation contract and resolves among three adapters: Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible (configurable base URL), and local Ollama. Provider resolution is owned by `data-service/llm_gateway.py`.
spec/ARCHITECTURE.md:- **Optional local GPU provider** — NVIDIA GPU reservation applies to Ollama only; cloud providers need no GPU

spec/DATABASE.md:- **Provenance transport (Phase 36 UAT F6, closed 2026-07-26):** provider/model/confidence are read and written by computgraph_publish.py for every recognized entity. A run falling back to local Ollama has no model id, so it records provider: ollama with a null model.

spec/DECISIONS.md:**Decision:** Route generation through data-service/llm_gateway.py and its one /llm/generate contract. The gateway resolves the active provider and model from saved settings and supports Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible (configurable base URL), and local Ollama adapters. API keys are encrypted at rest under LLM_MASTER_SECRET; Ollama remains the zero-config fallback when no API key is configured.

violations.message: The model's response was truncated at the 512-token cap with 1 residual candidates in scope. Where: the LLM response. How to fix: scope recognition to a single procedure_index to reduce the candidate count.

findings.title: Ollama llama3.1:8b emits explanatory prose before Cypher
findings.observed: The Ollama route reached the live ingest workflow, but execution result 263/264 attempted to send the prose prefix 'Here are the converted Cypher MERGE + SET statements for the given rule:' to Neo4j before the fenced Cypher block.
findings.consequence: The first Ollama attempt failed on prose-before-Cypher; a reconnect retry subsequently passed. The finding remains historical and does not block provider-switch acceptance.
